items.title: Radical immigration policy banning countries being considered by Liberals
items.description: Angus Taylor says he will unite the Liberal Party, but a deeper rift is forming between those who want to overhaul the party's direction and those who believe doing so would mean political death.

items.title: Live: Taylor says nuclear should be part of Australia's energy mix
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor says nuclear energy should form part of Australia's energy mix. Follow live.

items.title: Chalmers mocks Taylor's pitch for bipartisan budget savings taskforce
items.description: Angus Taylor wrote to the prime minister pitching the plan just days after being elected leader of the Liberal Party.

items.title: Bondi Beach gunman Naveed Akram fronts court for the first time
items.description: Bondi Beach gunman Naveed Akram, who is charged with 15 counts of murder, has appeared via video link for the first time in a Sydney court as a senior magistrate extended existing suppression orders in the case.

items.title: Live: Police investigating videos linked to elderly man's kidnapping
items.description: Detectives believe 85-year-old Chris Baghsarian was mistakenly snatched just after 5am last Friday from his bedroom after intruders forced their way into his North Ryde property.

items.title: Why a packet of Arnott's Shapes could help determine the 'case of the century'
items.description: The "case of the century" is set to play out in the federal court this month, with the ACCC taking on supermarket giant Coles for what it claims are "illusory" discounts.

items.title: SA Police return to remote station in search for missing boy Gus Lamont
items.description: Officers are at Oak Park Station in South Australia's north-east, where a four-year-old boy went missing almost five months ago.

items.title: AI got personal last week, and it's more complicated than we think
items.description: A fake news story about me, a series of AI breakthroughs and a resignation in the tech world show that 2026 could be pivotal for AI.

items.title: Cousin of Bondi Junction attack victim calls out stabber's misogyny
items.description: A bereaved family member of victim Jade Young feels many of his questions surrounding the deadly attack and its aftermath have been left unanswered from the inquest.

items.title: Glove appearing to match Guthrie footage found as DNA tested
items.description: The FBI says a glove containing DNA was found near the home of US TV show host Savannah Guthrie's mother and appears to match those worn by a masked person outside her front door the night she vanished.

items.title: Intermittent fasting 'no better than doing nothing at all', review finds
items.description: Intermittent fasting has become a popular phrase in dieting, promising health benefits including kickstarting metabolism and helping shed body fat but a major review suggests the diets may be over-hyped.

items.title: Record spike in whooping cough cases due to 'potentially catastrophic' trend
items.description: A "potentially catastrophic" decline in Australia's childhood vaccination rates has contributed to the sharpest increase in cases of whooping cough in 35 years, infectious diseases experts say.

items.title: Israel launches air strikes at Gaza days before Trump's Board of Peace meeting
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the first meeting of his newly created Board of Peace will take place on Thursday, with over $7 billion to be pledged for reconstruction and humanitarian efforts in Gaza.

items.title: The brilliant bronze of Australia's 'team captain' Matt Graham
items.description: Matt Graham's brilliant bronze in the dual moguls, and the incredible response from his teammates, proved to everyone that he is the true leader of this Winter Olympic squad.

items.title: Traditional owners 'won't accept' Argyle diamond mine site handback
items.description: East Kimberley traditional owners are concerned Rio Tinto's closure plan will leave them with "a giant hole in the ground forever".

items.title: As high-speed rail plans gather pace, Britain's HS2 offers hard lessons
items.description: While the federal government considers an ambitious plan, a similar project in the UK has seen its fair share of controversies.

items.title: Meet GayC/DC — the world’s only all-gay AC/DC tribute band
items.description: They worship the riffs, rewrite the lyrics and win over the toughest crowds. GayC/DC is a tribute band like no other.

items.title: How queer communities are finding strength in sport after hate
items.description: In places marked by historic violence and exclusion, queer communities are still showing up.

items.title: NSW Police ordered to pay $1.89m in legal costs after fishing trial collapses
items.description: Subpoenaed documents obtained by the ABC reveal NSW Police continued prosecuting seven men for illegally trafficking abalone despite advice that their case was likely to fail.

items.title: 'Extremely lenient': Box Hill North players sanctioned over inappropriate photos
items.description: The Box Hill North Football Club players involved in inappropriate photos posted online after their "Silly Saturday" post-season celebrations have been sanctioned by the league's governing body.

items.title: What can you eat on an island at the bottom of the world?
items.description: A tiny island off the coast of Tasmania is embracing old and new techniques to keep food on the table.

items.title: NT politician accused of bullying by two staffers, leaders stay silent
items.description: A Northern Territory politician has been accused of bullying by two female staffers while leading a parliamentary committee, the ABC can reveal.

items.title: Vermilion's Wandoo gas field halted by regulator after December oil spill
items.description: Exports from an oil field off WA's Pilbara are at a standstill after an oil spill in December. The regulator says it has identified "systemic failures" at the Canadian-owned Wandoo facility.

items.title: Scientist makes cider from 'feral' apples collected along country roads
items.description: Lucien Alperstein has spent the past decade picking feral apples from trees along country back roads and making cider. He says his guerilla activity inspired his curiosity in the science of genetics and fermentation.

items.title: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian Black Sea oil port
items.description: Two people are wounded in an attack on the port of Taman in the Krasnodar region, ahead of US-brokered peace talks between Ukraine and Russia.
